100 “Who's most likely to” questions

In Most Likely To, someone reads a question and on the count of three everyone points at the person who fits it best. These 100 questions are funny without being mean, so nobody leaves upset.

How to play

  1. Read the question out loud.
  2. Count to three, and everyone points at the person most likely to do it.
  3. Whoever gets the most fingers has to explain themselves.
  4. They read the next one.
